project_type: Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + GSAP scroll-driven image sequence website
test_framework: No test framework configured - no test files exist
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit to confirm TypeScript compiles without errors. 2. Run npm run build to confirm Next.js production build succeeds.
environment_constraints: node_modules not installed. Must run npm install first. No test runner configured so verification is TypeScript compilation + Next.js build.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Standard Next.js conventions apply.
key_patterns: - useSequencesPreload hook creates Image() elements for all frames and tracks progress via onload/onerror. Sets ready=true only when ALL images settle. - ImageSequencePlayer is imperative (uses drawFrame via ref) so scroll-tied animations can update without React renders. - imagesRef is a mutable ref object mapping sequence IDs to HTMLImageElement arrays, shared across all consumers. - Hero uses sequences 1st-vdo, 2nd-vdo, 3rd-vdo with a pinned ScrollTrigger. - ReservationMotionSection and ContactSection use 4th-vdo (below the fold). - Preloader component shows animated progress bar until ready=true.
directory_structure: src/hooks/ - custom React hooks. src/components/ - all UI components. src/components/story/ - image sequence related components. src/components/Hero/ - hero section. src/lib/story/ - transition controller utilities. public/1st-vdo through 4th-vdo - 300 JPG frames each.
